assessments.reasoning: The release-pinned SPDX detail lists licenseId OLDAP-2.8, display name “Open LDAP Public License v2.8”, and isDeprecatedLicenseId false. Its licenseText opens with 17 August 2003 and its crossRef and seeAlso fields both give the HTTP release-page URL.
GitHub’s SPDX repository tag object names v3.29.0 and points to commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, exactly the revision serving OLDAP-2.8.json. The API reports the tag as unsigned.

The publisher’s HTTPS acquisition supplies the second locator and the full-page revision in scope. Its Foundation-attributed PRE block identifies version 2.8 and the same edition date as the SPDX licenseText.

challenge.method: Compare the literal URL schemes without normalization. Check whether SPDX’s match flag, the general page heading, or the adjacent 2.7 gitweb reference could substitute for direct inspection of the HTTPS inline edition.
challenge.results: Both SPDX citation fields retain HTTP. Only the publisher acquisition records HTTPS. The historical SPDX match string “true” concerns its cited reference. The inline date and “in source form” wording confirm the 2.8 edition, while the 2.7 gitweb URL names a different witness.

limitations: The HTTP citation is observable in SPDX. Its response, redirect behavior, and byte relationship to the HTTPS page remain unverified. The cross-reference match flag supplies no legal-equivalence finding.
